title: Ochratoxin C induces zebrafish embryonic neurodevelopmental defects and cerebral hemorrhaging by downregulating Notch signaling.
authors: Hu, Boxi; Yang, Dou; Yuan, Qiang; Wang, Zhipeng; Liu, Jiejun; Xu, Jiali; Liu, Fasheng; Zhang, Shouhua; Liao, Xinjun; Xiao, Juhua; Cao, Zigang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究赭曲霉毒素C对斑马鱼胚胎神经发育的毒性机制，涉及Notch信号通路和分子对接，但核心是毒理学表型而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Ochratoxin C (OTC) is a commonly overlooked toxin in the ochratoxin family, found in moldy crops and poultry meat. However, its potential toxicity should not be ignored and needs further elucidation. In this study, we evaluated the neurotoxicity of OTC during zebrafish embryonic development. The results show that OTC affects the overall zebrafish embryonic development, resulting in reduced body length, abnormal hatching, increased yolk sac area, and decreased tail flick frequency. Additionally, OTC specifically induces cerebral hemorrhaging and abnormal motor behavior in these embryos, accompanied by changes in neurotransmitter and neurodevelopment-related gene expression levels. Furthermore, OTC induces upregulation of oxidative stress levels and downregulation of acetylcholinesterase (AChE) activity and adenosine triphosphatase (ATPase) activity, leading to cell apoptosis.Transcriptional assays and transgenic fluorescence photography show that OTC can inhibit Notch signaling pathway. Partial restoration of cerebral hemorrhage and neurodevelopmental defects can be achieved by administering the Notch signaling activator, sodium propionate. Molecular docking analysis indicates that the gene SLC22A6 (corresponding to the human gene OAT1) as the binding target protein for OTC. In conclusion, OTC exposure may lead to zebrafish embryonic neurodevelopmental defects and cerebral hemorrhage by downregulating Notch signaling. This work provides insight into the potential threat of OTC to embryonic development.
abstract_zh: 赭曲毒素C (Ochratoxin C, OTC) 是赭曲毒素家族中一种常被忽视的毒素，存在于发霉作物和禽肉中。然而，其潜在毒性不容忽视，需进一步阐明。在本研究中，我们评估了OTC在斑马鱼胚胎发育过程中的神经毒性。结果表明，OTC影响斑马鱼胚胎的整体发育，导致体长缩短、孵化异常、卵黄囊面积增大及尾部摆动频率降低。此外，OTC特异性地诱导这些胚胎出现脑出血和异常运动行为，并伴随神经递质及神经发育相关基因表达水平的变化。进一步地，OTC诱导氧化应激水平上调，以及乙酰胆碱酯酶 (acetylcholinesterase, AChE) 活性和三磷酸腺苷酶 (adenosine triphosphatase, ATPase) 活性下调，从而导致细胞凋亡。转录分析和转基因荧光摄影显示，OTC可抑制Notch信号通路。通过施用Notch信号激活剂丙酸钠，可部分恢复脑出血和神经发育缺陷。分子对接分析表明，基因SLC22A6（对应人类基因OAT1）是OTC的结合靶蛋白。总之，OTC暴露可能通过下调Notch信号导致斑马鱼胚胎神经发育缺陷和脑出血。这项工作为OTC对胚胎发育的潜在威胁提供了见解。
